credit: Blender Studio and community contributions (Blender Foundation), Human Base Meshes asset bundle
note: Human Base Meshes v1.4.1 (human-base-meshes-bundle-v1.4.1.zip from mirror.blender.org). The bundle is one .blend; the two realistic full bodies (female, male; they share one topology) are exported to human-base-meshes/body-*.glb at the BASE LEVEL (multires and subsurf off), smooth-shaded (the .blend has them flat, which split every corner), each moved to the origin (the bundle lays them side by side) with its two eyes parented to it, no materials. A-pose, facing +Z, metres (1.65 and 1.69 m), quads triangulated, about 23k triangles, 560 KB each. Inputs for tosijs-3d's universal character builder (auto-rig any mesh). The stylized bodies are not shipped (Tonio, 2026-10-29: 'horrible'). The .blend and the heads, hands, feet, skulls and primitives are not exported.
